title: Data consolidation (client entities, client variables, type objects, data signatures) and expressions/literals

capabilities.title: ClientEntity (IClientEntity)
capabilities.summary: Local storage on the device: create IClientEntity at @espace, add an Id IEntityAttribute (Long Integer, IsAutoNumber No) and set IdentifierAttribute; other attributes are the data.entity 'entity attribute' role. Records are written through its entity action CreateOrUpdate<Name> and read by a client-side screen aggregate.

route.operation: create IClientEntity at @espace; create IEntityAttribute Id + set DataType "Long Integer", IsAutoNumber "No"; set <entity> IdentifierAttribute $id; ({"op":"spec","data":{"clientEntities":[...]}} is a compiler contract without a suite job)

capabilities.guidance: Declare the Id first (Long Integer, IsAutoNumber No: the device owns the id), then IdentifierAttribute. Write records with IExecuteClientActionNode + set Action IEntityActionSignature:CreateOrUpdate<Name> and <node>/Source Value; read them with a screen aggregate created with args.isClientSide true. Do not make it public: expose a public structure instead.

recommends.when: attributes of the client entity (role entity attribute: Id, DataType, IsMandatory)
the client action that writes it with CreateOrUpdate<Name>
reading it on a screen (screen aggregate with args.isClientSide, source = the client entity)

read.route: get IClientEntity:<Name> (IdentifierAttribute and properties); dump for its attributes

odc.scope: get of a new client entity shows its IdentifierAttribute; get of the Id shows Long Integer without AutoNumber

o11.note: no O11 job reads a client entity

create.route: create IClientEntity at @espace, then its attributes (data.entity role entity attribute)
preconditions: Id attribute Long Integer with IsAutoNumber No (the kernel's clientEntities default; the device owns the id)
set IdentifierAttribute after the Id exists
not public (the spec compiler refuses a public client entity)

odc.scope: new client entity with Id, a Text and a Date Time attribute in an app module; written through its entity action and read by a client-side screen aggregate

o11.scope: same shape in a mobile module (two jobs)

o11.scope: IdentifierAttribute of a new client entity in a mobile module

limits.text: Public client entities are not preserved by native merge in this Studio build: the spec compiler refuses them; expose a public structure instead.

usages, rename, replace, duplicate and delete of a client entity have no job.

capabilities.title: ClientVariable (IClientVariable)
capabilities.summary: A client variable is an app-level value kept per user on the device: create IClientVariable at @espace and set DataType (Description optional). Expressions read it and assignments write it as Client.<Name>; usages lists those expressions and rename rewrites them.

route.operation: create IClientVariable at @espace; set DataType "<type>" (Description); cite it in expressions as Client.<Name>; usages / rename IClientVariable:<Name>

capabilities.guidance: Types are set by name (Text, Integer, Date Time...). The default value is a method (SetDefaultValue), not a writable property: no job sets it. Session variables do not exist on ODC: the client variable is the per-user state there.

recommends.when: the assignment that writes Client.<Name> in an action flow
renaming it (the expressions that cite it are rewritten by key)

odc.note: no job reads the variable itself (get/dump); its consumers are read with usages

o11.note: no O11 job reads a client variable

odc.scope: new client variables (Text, Integer) at the app root, then read on a screen and written by an assignment

o11.scope: a Text client variable in a reactive module

odc.scope: DataType (Text, Integer) and Description of a new client variable
consumers are the expressions that cite it: a screen expression that reads it and the assignment that writes it
rename of an inherited client variable rewrote Client.<Name> in the expressions that cite it (an assignment in a system event and a screen expression), read back with get and usages

limits.text: The default value is written by a method (SetDefaultValue), not a writable property; no job sets it.
read (get/dump of the variable), delete, duplicate and move of a client variable have no job.
Session variables do not exist on ODC (the factory refuses); the client variable is the per-user state.

differences: no session variables on ODC: the client variable is the per-user state

limits.text: One O11 job proves create/set; usages, rename and reading the variable back are not exercised on O11.
O11 also has session variables (IESpace.CreateSessionVariable) but no O11 job creates one: they are not represented here.

capabilities.title: ExpressionText, IListLiteralItem, IRecordLiteralField
capabilities.summary: An expression is OutSystems text written with `set` on an expression property of its owner (Value, Condition, DefaultValue...). ODC: '{Name: v}' and '[a, b]' written on a virgin argument Value become record/list literals (items and fields); a list literal item can also be created. Only built-in functions of the loaded Studio exist; the kernel adds UnknownFunction and Current hints before the Verify.

route.operation: set {target:<owner>, prop:<expression property>, value:"<OutSystems text>"}; ODC literals: set <call>/<Input> Value "{A: 1}" | "[{A: 1}, {A: 2}]" on a virgin argument; create IListLiteralItem under <arg>/#IListLiteralExpression + set Value; read: get/dump <owner>

capabilities.guidance: Expression values are JSON strings holding OutSystems text: "True", "\"Hello\"", "GetX.List.Current.E.Attr". Other-language names (Right, Left, Len, IIf, Now, ToString) do not exist: use Substr, Length, If, CurrDateTime. Expressions that cite nodes, variables and attributes follow a rename by key; literal text inside quotes does not. The Expression widget on a screen is front B (ui.*), not this capability.

recommends.when: the owner of the expression is an assignment, If or Switch condition
a literal goes into a call argument, or a '<X> List' DataType is needed
renaming an element that expressions cite (they are rewritten by key)

alternatives.when: an Expression widget that shows a value on a screen (front B owns the widget)

odc.address: created from the text '{Name: value}'; read with dump of the owning argument
